name: Agent S
description: Computer-use agent framework that operates macOS, Windows and Linux desktops through screenshots, planning and grounded mouse and keyboard actions.
whatItDoes: Carries out desktop tasks described in plain language by controlling the real graphical interface of the machine it runs on. It is used by researchers and developers building or benchmarking general computer-use agents.
howItWorks: A main reasoning model reads a screenshot and decides the next step, while a separate grounding model converts the described target into screen coordinates. The resulting click and type actions are executed on the host, and the loop repeats. An optional flag lets it run local code as well.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key when OpenAI is the reasoning provider

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key when Anthropic is the reasoning provider

requirements.name: HF_TOKEN
requirements.description: Hugging Face token for the grounding endpoint

requirements.name: Grounding model endpoint
requirements.description: Served grounding model such as UI-TARS-1.5-7B reachable by URL

run: agent_s --provider openai --model gpt-5-2025-08-07 --ground_provider huggingface --ground_url http://localhost:8080 --ground_model ui-tars-1.5-7b --grounding_width 1920 --grounding_height 1080
models: OpenAI, Anthropic and others for reasoning; UI-TARS for grounding
